summary_1line: Demonesses in Lanka try to persuade Sita to accept Ravana as husband by praising his lineage, power, and wealth.

image_candidates.scene_text: A circle of grotesque demonesses with blazing eyes crowd around the sorrowful Sita beneath a tree, angrily urging her to accept Ravana.
One furious demoness with catlike rolling eyes points accusingly at Sita while boasting of Ravana’s victories over gods and celestial beings.
